---
title: "Media Viewer Pixel Rulers"
format: html
---

## Overview

The Media Viewer displays Inkscape-style horizontal and vertical rulers along the top and left edges of the canvas. Rulers show **media/source pixel coordinates** (the same space as `MediaCoordinates` and `CanvasCoordinateSystem`), and update automatically when the user zooms or pans.

## Components

| Component | Location | Role |
|-----------|----------|------|
| `HorizontalAxisWidget` | Reused from `Plots/Common` | Top ruler (`AxisDisplayMode::Ruler`) |
| `VerticalAxisWidget` | Reused from `Plots/Common` | Left ruler (inverted Y, left-edge ticks) |
| `RulerCornerWidget` | `Media_Widget/UI/Rulers` | Top-left corner square |
| `MediaRuler_Widget` | Properties panel | User preferences |
| `MediaRulerViewport.hpp` | `computeVisibleMediaViewport()` | Scene-to-media coordinate mapping |
| `AxisTickLayout.hpp` | `Plots/Common` | Shared tick interval math |

## Coordinate Mapping

Visible media-pixel bounds are computed from the `QGraphicsView` transform:

```cpp
scene_tl = view.mapToScene(viewport.topLeft())
media_x = scene_x / x_aspect
```

Aspect ratios come from `Media_Window::getXAspect()` / `getYAspect()`.

## State

Ruler preferences are stored in `RulerPrefs` inside `MediaWidgetStateData` and exposed via `MediaWidgetState::rulerPrefs()` / `setRulerPrefs()`. Changes emit `rulerPrefsChanged()`.

## Signal Wiring

`Media_Widget::_setupRulerLayout()` connects ruler repaints to:

- `zoomChanged`, `panChanged`, `canvasCoordinateSystemChanged`, `rulerPrefsChanged`
- Scroll bar `valueChanged` (live pan drag)
- `resizeEvent`
